text:
kai: Heads-up — thinking we need to reshuffle the onboarding probe sequence for a subset of quantized models. Bench results show flakiness at seqlen 2048 and KV-cache warmups. Propose: split perf-smoke vs compatibility-smoke, run perf on dedicated infra with latency SLO gating before binary acceptance.

marta: seen the same. variance at p95 jumps after warmup. add golden replay earlier and baseline percentiles (p50/p95/p99) as thresholds. :thumbsup:

lee: infra q — can we reuse smokehouse pool or need dedicated reserved GPUs? reuse increases queue times for other onboards.

kai: reuse OK for low-priority incoming models but heavy prebench should go to dedicated pool. also add a 'fastpath' KV check (short seq sequences) to catch serialization/ordering regressions quickly.

bench-bot: runner started 1757654325 — perf-smoke(model=redwood-quant-v1, seqlen=512) on pool=smokehouse-2. logs: https://ci.internal/bench/1757654325

marta: validator checklist note — run both FP16 and quantized binary. compute artifact checksum and store fingerprint; fail admission if fingerprint differs from registry expected.

lee: compatibility checklist: ONNX export sanity + runtime ABI smoke, and tokenizer parity. tokenizer shifts often cause scoring drifts.

kai: API change proposal: onboarding/admit returns admit_score (pass|warn|fail) + artifacts array (perf_report, golden_replay, checksum, tokenizer_diff). gating: perf gating only enforced for hosted tier; Private deployments skip perf SLO enforcement but still require compatibility checks.

sam: timeline? I can help update smoke runner config and add the fastpath. target next-week rollout for the sequence reshuffle. anyone object?

marta: no objections. i'll draft the minimal schema for admit response and the percentiles gating thresholds.

kai: awesome — marta/sam will pair to update smoke config and validator contract. i'll file a short RFC for the new admit schema.

lee: small follow-up — let's add a soft-fail (warn) path that notifies model-owner but allows canary until manual signoff.

kai: agreed, warn bubble + 24h auto-retry. thanks everyone. :rocket:
